name: Yomi S
description: Yomi S is the second-generation robotic guidance system developed by Neocis for dental and maxillofacial surgery. It features a smaller cart footprint and redesigned robotic arm kinematics intended to preserve line-of-sight to the oral cavity. Integrated foot pedals and a touchscreen allow single-operator control during surgery. The platform incorporates YomiPlan AI software for automated segmentation of CBCT scans (such as the inferior alveolar nerve canal, maxillary sinus boundaries, and tooth roots). The articulated robotic arm provides haptic guidance and physical boundary constraints during osteotomy preparation, implant insertion, guided bone reduction (alveoloplasty), and pterygoid implant placement.
